title: Momcozy Breast Pump Hands-Free Mobile Style Wearable M6 24mm, 2Pcs Cozy Red
bullets: Ideal Rhythm, Boosts Milk Supply: Through over 1,000 trials, the Momcozy R&D team has perfected a pumping rhythm that enhances comfort while effectively increasing milk production.It supports everyday baby essentials needs.

2nd Gen Motor, Strong Suction: The advanced 2nd Gen motor delivers a powerful 295 mmHg suction, with 3 modes (Stimulation, Expression, Mixed) and 9 adjustable levels for a more comfortable and efficient pumping experience.

More Fit & Discreet: Designed to fit seamlessly into your bra, the Momcozy wearable pump is based on a best-selling cup mold that contours to your breast shape, offering superior discretion and freedom to pump anytime, anywhere.
DoubleFit Flange, Ultimate Comfort: Featuring a unique soft and hard silicone dual-seal flange, the Momcozy pump ensures maximum comfort, safety, and easy flange installation.
Stand-Up Milk Bowl Design: The stand-up milk collector simplifies pumping and pouring, making it easier to transfer milk into milk bags or bottles without spills.
